name: Tianjin Port Co., Ltd.
summary: Tianjin Port Co., Ltd., headquartered in Tianjin, China, operates primarily as a port and logistics enterprise within the country. Its core business revolves around maritime terminal operations, including the loading and unloading of various types of cargo. The company's comprehensive service portfolio also extends to commodity storage, multimodal transportation solutions, and specialized automobile logistics. Furthermore, Tianjin Port Co., Ltd. manages container handling and unpacking activities, offers economic advisory services, and facilitates freight forwarding. Beyond its logistics and port operations, the company is involved in the wholesale and retail trade of a diverse range of commercial products and materials.
